scope: Normative-source finite models, not independently observed implementation reviews

provenance.requirement: One-use authorization code bound to client identifier and redirect URI
provenance.decoder: Model exporter supplies the consumed flag for one unexpired code; client authentication/URI parsing already resolved
provenance.candidates: Two unresolved client-record mappings and two redirect-record mappings supplied as review hypotheses, not source-text ambiguity
provenance.excluded: Expiry, PKCE, cryptography, HTTP errors, concurrent redemption, and the recommended token revocation after replay

records.canonical_sentence:
principals are "client-a", "client-b".
resources are "redirect-a", "redirect-b".
actions are "redeem".
roles are none.
state "used" initially false.
alias principal "client" is one of "client-a", "client-b".
alias resource "redirect" is one of "redirect-a", "redirect-b".
allow when principal is alias "client" and resource is alias "redirect" and state "used" is false then set state "used" to true.
otherwise deny.
records.review_action: Restore the state-update edge when no binding matches; settle issuer record mapping separately when a proper family matches. Do not shrink the admitted family to hide a failure.

provenance.requirement: Invalidate the actual token and optionally related tokens under the declared server policy
provenance.decoder: Exporter supplies the revocation record for token-a; one related token is identified by an unresolved same-grant mapping
provenance.candidates: Related token is token-b or token-c under the fixed revoke-related policy; issuer metadata must settle this, not the RFC
provenance.excluded: Authentication, propagation delay, network protocol, arbitrary token population and HTTP 200 versus access denial

records.canonical_sentence:
principals are "authenticated-client".
resources are "token-a", "token-b", "token-c".
actions are "revoke", "use".
roles are none.
state "revocation_seen" initially false.
alias resource "same-grant" is one of "token-b", "token-c".
allow when action is "revoke" and resource is "token-a" then set state "revocation_seen" to true.
deny when action is "use" and state "revocation_seen" is true and resource is "token-a".
deny when action is "use" and state "revocation_seen" is true and resource is alias "same-grant".
allow when action is "use" then keep state.
otherwise deny.
records.review_action: Restore the state-update edge when no binding matches; settle issuer record mapping separately when a proper family matches. Do not shrink the admitted family to hide a failure.
